Dutchman Convert turns designs from other CAD programs into native SolidCraft designs, keeping as much of their feature history, sketches, and assemblies as it can. 0.2.0 is a big step: it now knows 12 formats, and far more of a design's history comes through.

## What's new

- **12 formats.** Fusion, Inventor, FreeCAD, and SolidWorks parts as before, plus **CATIA V5, Rhino, ACIS, Creo View, and STEP** (as shapes). Creo and NX `.prt` files are recognised, with shapes still to come. For IGES, Dutchman points you to SolidCraft's own importer (File > Import), which handles it better for now. Run `dutchman formats` to see where each one stands.
- **More history comes through.** Fillets and chamfers, holes (with chamfered entries and thread labels), more kinds of revolves, sweeps, lofts, patterns, mirrors, body booleans, and more sketch curves, constraints, and dimensions now arrive as editable features instead of flat shapes. When something can't be mapped, the report says exactly why.
- **Better assemblies.** Joints come in facing the right way, parts that nothing holds in place are grounded, and an assembly keeps its own sketches for reference.
- **Easier to install and run.** `brew install dutchman-cad/tap/dutchman` on macOS and Linux, Scoop on Windows. Convert with just `dutchman part.f3d`. `dutchman pilot` runs [Pilot](https://github.com/dutchman-cad/pilot).
- **A friendlier desktop app.** It's now called Dutchman Convert, the Mac disk image installs by drag and drop, and it explains the macOS first-run prompt.
- **Telling us when a file fails is one click.** A failed file offers **Report this on GitHub** with the details filled in. To send the file itself privately, DM Dutchy in the [Dutchman CAD Discord](https://discord.gg/yTcseBEdeu): only the team sees it, and it's how the readers get better.
- **FreeCAD output (experimental).** Write native FreeCAD documents with `--to fcstd`, or rebuild macros with `--to freecad`.

## Known issue

A few SolidWorks parts that 0.1.5 read now come out empty or with fewer bodies. Dutchman reports this as a loss, not as a clean conversion, and a fix is in progress. If 0.1.5 worked better for a part, keep using it for that part for now.

Made for the current SolidCraft (any release from the last two weeks); older versions get simplified features, or pass `--solidcraft-version`.
